classes.aristotelian_definition: A AminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that contains an amino group (NH2) and a carboxyl group (-COOH).
An EssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that cannot be produced by the body and must be obtained through food.
A SemiEssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be produced in the body but its production may not be sufficient.
A NonEssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be produced by the body and does not require supplementation through food.
